audits.cleanReason: Full sweep of every not/n't/no/never/nothing/nobody sentence (about 150 negation-bearing sentences). Most are plain factual absences ('no bell in it', 'The granary had no windows', 'No lock on the bar') or prohibitions ('Nobody comes in armed', 'No bread', 'Nobody bakes, nobody sells') and are not contrast constructions. The 24 real contrast-shaped candidates were run through the decision procedure. Each keep meets a listed condition. Binary diagnostic: L56 imagined 'not a fever. It is a contamination' (fever vs contamination is the live question Brask and Tobin answer with 'It's fever'), L230 and L310 localisation chains ('Nothing in the lungs, nothing in the blood'), L456 control-group criteria, L466 'Not grain, then. One flour.' (oats vs store flour changes what Tobin feeds them at L472), and L536 the water/contact/bread elimination. Hard constraint: L29, L176, L286, L322, L354, L358, L697, L831 'I can ward a room. I can't ward a village.', L901. Self-argument: L378 'So it wasn't the water. It might still be the water', L454 'No. Slower.', L877. Factual negations whose deletion would lose a plot fact: L45, L214, L506, L801. No pivot rhythm shared between narration and dialogue, and no clusters. The newly revised L286 ('She had put it round a hundred flasks and never once round a woman.') puts the positive half first. The negation is the payload: this is her first ward on a person, and the stakes beat at L300 depends on it. Keep rate is high because the remaining contrast shapes are diagnostic reasoning in an epidemiology chapter. Each keep was re-checked against the five adversarial self-check questions.

audits.secondSweepP5P6: Re-read every sentence for inanimate or abstract subjects carrying verbs of agency, desire, cognition, combustion or physical behaviour, and for body-part subjects and demoted actors. Roads and geography: L621 'A stair ... climbed the inner wall' and L1021 'The other went off south and west' are fictive-motion path verbs of the 'the road led' kind, with no intent. L963 'The bakehouse sent none' is chimney emission, and the actor is not demoted because Brask's shutdown is already on the page. Receiver nouns or instrument phrases: L254, L270 and L378 'the jug had read thin' use mage measurement idiom for a sample, and Jaina is the on-page reader in every case. L548 'Ellen's loaf had gone up the lane' is goods-in-transit motion with no intent, and L400 names Ellen as sender. L536 'it doesn't sort them ... What sorts them is bread' is Jaina's spoken variable-explains-distribution idiom, backed in the same speech by named cases. No human sorter is displaced. Body-part subjects: L74/78/96/711/821/841 (Brask's thumb), L296, L302, L593, L601, L643, L681 'of their own accord', L691 'her eye had slid off', L719, L785 and L951 are all involuntary (nerves, sleep, seizure, nausea, cold, numbness), and the involuntariness is the point. L625 'Her head came up over the edge of the loft' is spatial: only her head has cleared the floor, and Tam sees it as 'a turnip' at L631. No abstract state settles into a body part. No metaphor chains give one inanimate subject a run of human verbs. Subject-matter mechanisms (currents, drag, wards, the staff crystal, the built construct with 'one part to wait') stay on literal in-world behaviour verbs.
audits.cleanReason: No Pattern 1-11 kills. There are no permission tags: every 'let' is physical letting go of an object or hold (L198, L218, L330, L719, L923). There are no nominalised agents apart from one Pattern 9 exception at L446 ('It went through her like the first warm swallow of wine'). The exception is allowed once per chapter for the moment the answer arrives, and this is the only use. Pattern 4 institutional self-deception: none. The slop checker raised no intent-smear tool signals (abstract_locomotion and inanimate_agency both zero). Magical-instrument and plague-mechanism verbs ('The crystal woke', 'The staff woke in her arm', 'the ward took it and held', 'sat down in him and waited', 'The staff shifted ... leaning toward the ruts') are kept under the subject-matter defense and keep condition 3, as literal behaviour of the chapter's named mechanisms. Full rationale is in the scratchpad.
